common.notReported: Not reported by the connector yet.
common.needsAudit: Needs the GetSafe 360 plugin 1.6 or newer.
common.notEvaluated: This check could not be evaluated.
common.noTitle: The page has no title to measure.
common.noDescription: The page has no meta description to measure.
common.pageNotRead: The page content could not be read.

wp-core-version.title: WordPress core version
wp-core-version.recommendation: Update WordPress core to the latest stable version.
wp-core-version.updateAvailable: Running {version}; WordPress reports a newer version is available.
wp-core-version.unknown: Core version could not be determined.

wp-login-exposed.title: Login page protection
wp-login-exposed.recommendation: Restrict /wp-login.php and add rate limiting and a CAPTCHA.
wp-login-exposed.unknown: Login protection has not been probed yet.
wp-login-exposed.protected: The login endpoint is rate-limited or protected.
wp-login-exposed.exposed: The default login endpoint is reachable without protection.

wp-user-enumeration.title: User enumeration
wp-user-enumeration.recommendation: Block author archives and REST username listing for anonymous visitors.
wp-user-enumeration.blocked: Username enumeration is blocked by GetSafe 360.
wp-user-enumeration.exposed: WordPress lists usernames publicly by default, and GetSafe 360 protection is off.

wp-xmlrpc.title: XML-RPC exposure
wp-xmlrpc.recommendation: Disable XML-RPC unless an app or service explicitly needs it.
wp-xmlrpc.turnedOff: XML-RPC is turned off on this site.
wp-xmlrpc.notReachable: The XML-RPC endpoint is not reachable.
wp-xmlrpc.reachable: The XML-RPC endpoint responds to public requests.
wp-xmlrpc.enabled: XML-RPC is enabled on this site.
wp-xmlrpc.defaultOn: WordPress enables XML-RPC by default, and GetSafe 360 protection is off.
wp-xmlrpc.unknown: XML-RPC state could not be determined.

wp-debug-mode.title: WP debug mode
wp-debug-mode.recommendation: Set WP_DEBUG to false on production, or at least WP_DEBUG_DISPLAY to false.
wp-debug-mode.display: PHP errors are shown to visitors, which can reveal file paths and internals.
wp-debug-mode.on: Debug mode is on (errors are not shown to visitors).

wp-vulnerable-plugins.title: Known vulnerable plugins
wp-vulnerable-plugins.recommendation: Patch, replace, or remove vulnerable plugins immediately.
wp-vulnerable-plugins.found: {count, plural, one {# plugin has} other {# plugins have}} known vulnerabilities.

wp-outdated-plugins.title: Outdated plugins
wp-outdated-plugins.recommendation: Update plugins in batches and verify compatibility.
wp-outdated-plugins.upToDate: All plugins are up to date.
wp-outdated-plugins.outdated: {count, plural, one {# plugin has an update} other {# plugins have updates}} available.

wp-object-cache.title: Object cache
wp-object-cache.recommendation: Enable a persistent object cache (Redis or Memcached).
wp-object-cache.enabled: A persistent object cache is enabled.

wp-gzip.title: Compression
wp-gzip.recommendation: Enable Brotli or gzip compression at the server or CDN.

seo-sitemap.title: Sitemap availability
seo-sitemap.recommendation: Make /sitemap.xml reachable and list it in robots.txt.
seo-sitemap.unknown: The sitemap has not been probed yet.

red-flag-hidden-plugins.title: Hidden plugin behavior
red-flag-hidden-plugins.recommendation: Cross-check database plugin rows against the admin plugin list.

red-flag-core-modifications.title: Modified core files
red-flag-core-modifications.recommendation: Reinstall WordPress core from Dashboard → Updates, then review how the files were changed.
red-flag-core-modifications.unknown: Core file checksums could not be verified.
red-flag-core-modifications.modified: {count, plural, one {# WordPress core file differs} other {# WordPress core files differ}} from the official release.
red-flag-core-modifications.clean: All core files match the official WordPress checksums.

wp-admin-username.title: Predictable admin username
wp-admin-username.recommendation: Create a new administrator with a unique username, move content to it, then delete the "admin" account.
wp-admin-username.pass: No administrator uses "admin" or "administrator" as username.
wp-admin-username.fail: An administrator account uses the username "admin" or "administrator", the first guess of every brute-force attack.

wp-admin-count.title: Number of administrators
wp-admin-count.recommendation: Keep administrator accounts to the people who need them; give others Editor or Author roles.
wp-admin-count.ok: {count, plural, one {# administrator account} other {# administrator accounts}}.

wp-open-admin-registration.title: Open registration as administrator
wp-open-admin-registration.recommendation: Set Settings → General → New User Default Role to Subscriber, or turn off "Anyone can register".
wp-open-admin-registration.fail: Anyone can register, and new accounts become administrators. This is a common sign of a hacked site.

wp-file-editing.title: Theme and plugin file editor
wp-file-editing.pass: The built-in code editor is disabled.
wp-file-editing.fail: Administrators can edit theme and plugin code from the dashboard; a stolen login becomes code execution.

wp-salts.title: Security keys and salts
wp-salts.recommendation: Generate fresh keys at api.wordpress.org/secret-key/1.1/salt/ and replace them in wp-config.php.
wp-salts.pass: All eight security keys and salts are set and unique.
wp-salts.fail: Security keys or salts are missing, default or duplicated, which weakens login cookies.

wp-db-prefix.title: Database table prefix
wp-db-prefix.recommendation: Use a custom table prefix on new installs; changing it on a live site needs a careful migration.
wp-db-prefix.default: Tables use the default "wp_" prefix, which makes automated SQL-injection payloads easier.

wp-https.title: HTTPS site address
wp-https.recommendation: Install a TLS certificate and set both WordPress and Site Address to https:// in Settings → General.
wp-https.fail: The site address is configured as http://, so logins and forms travel unencrypted.

wp-config-permissions.title: wp-config.php permissions
wp-config-permissions.recommendation: Set wp-config.php permissions to 640 or 600 so other accounts on the server cannot read it.
wp-config-permissions.unknown: wp-config.php permissions could not be read.
wp-config-permissions.worldReadable: wp-config.php, which holds the database password, is readable by every account on the server.

wp-php-version.title: PHP version
wp-php-version.recommendation: Ask your host to switch the site to PHP 8.3 or newer, after testing on a staging copy.
wp-php-version.unknown: The PHP version was not reported.
wp-php-version.eol: PHP {branch} no longer receives security fixes{hasEnd, select, yes { (ended {endsOn})} other {}}.
wp-php-version.ending: PHP {branch} stops receiving security fixes on {endsOn}.
wp-php-version.uninterpretable: PHP version "{version}" could not be interpreted.

wp-debug-log.title: Debug log
wp-debug-log.recommendation: Turn off WP_DEBUG_LOG on production, or write the log outside the web root.
wp-debug-log.on: Errors are logged to wp-content/debug.log, which is publicly downloadable by default.

wp-inactive-plugins.title: Inactive plugins
wp-inactive-plugins.recommendation: Delete plugins you no longer use; inactive code can still be exploited.
wp-inactive-plugins.found: {count, plural, one {# installed plugin is} other {# installed plugins are}} inactive.

wp-unused-themes.title: Unused themes
wp-unused-themes.recommendation: Keep the active theme and one default theme as a fallback; delete the rest.

wp-theme-update.title: Active theme updates
wp-theme-update.recommendation: Update the active theme (use a child theme for customizations so updates are safe).
wp-theme-update.unknown: Theme update data is not available yet.
wp-theme-update.available: An update is available for the active theme.
wp-theme-update.upToDate: The active theme is up to date.

wp-autoload-size.title: Autoloaded options
wp-autoload-size.recommendation: Find large autoloaded options (often left by removed plugins) and set them to not autoload or delete them.
wp-autoload-size.large: {size} of options load on every request; above 1 MB this slows every page.
wp-autoload-size.elevated: {size} of options load on every request.

wp-expired-transients.title: Expired transients
wp-expired-transients.recommendation: Clean up expired transients; a persistent object cache prevents the build-up.
wp-expired-transients.many: {count, number} expired transients are still stored.

wp-revisions.title: Post revisions
wp-revisions.recommendation: Limit revisions with define('WP_POST_REVISIONS', 10); and remove old ones.
wp-revisions.ok: {count, plural, one {# post revision} other {# post revisions}}.

wp-cron.title: Scheduled tasks (WP-Cron)
wp-cron.recommendation: If DISABLE_WP_CRON is set, add a real server cron that calls wp-cron.php every 5 minutes.
wp-cron.disabledOverdue: WP-Cron is disabled and {count, plural, one {# task is} other {# tasks are}} more than an hour overdue; no replacement cron seems to run.
wp-cron.overdue: {count} scheduled tasks are more than an hour overdue.

wp-page-cache.title: Page cache
wp-page-cache.recommendation: Enable a page cache plugin or your host’s built-in page cache.
wp-page-cache.active: A WordPress page cache is active.
wp-page-cache.missing: No WordPress page cache was found. A server or CDN cache may still be in place.

wp-opcache.title: PHP OPcache
wp-opcache.recommendation: Ask your host to enable OPcache.
wp-opcache.off: OPcache is off, so PHP recompiles code on every request.

wp-memory-limit.title: PHP memory limit
wp-memory-limit.recommendation: Raise memory_limit to at least 256M with your host.
wp-memory-limit.unlimited: No PHP memory limit is set.
wp-memory-limit.low: PHP may use only {size}; larger sites run out of memory.

red-flag-uploads-php.title: PHP files in uploads
red-flag-uploads-php.recommendation: Review PHP files in wp-content/uploads; uploads should only hold media. Block PHP execution there at the server.
red-flag-uploads-php.unknown: The uploads folder could not be scanned in time.
red-flag-uploads-php.found: {count, plural, one {# PHP file} other {# PHP files}} found in the uploads folder, a common place for backdoors.
red-flag-uploads-php.none: No PHP files in the uploads folder.

sec-hsts.title: Missing HSTS header
sec-hsts.missing: Strict-Transport-Security is not set, so a visitor’s first request can be downgraded to plain HTTP and intercepted.
sec-hsts.notApplicable: HSTS requires HTTPS, which the site does not serve yet.

sec-csp.title: No Content-Security-Policy
sec-csp.recommendation: Start with a report-only policy, then tighten it once violations are understood.
sec-csp.missing: Without a CSP, any injected script on the page executes with full privileges.

sec-nosniff.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options
sec-nosniff.missing: Browsers may MIME-sniff responses, which can turn an uploaded file into executable script.

sec-referrer-policy.title: No Referrer-Policy
sec-referrer-policy.missing: Full URLs are leaked to third-party sites in the Referer header.

sec-frame-options.title: No clickjacking protection
sec-frame-options.recommendation: Send X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN or a CSP frame-ancestors directive.
sec-frame-options.missing: Neither X-Frame-Options nor a CSP frame-ancestors directive was found, so the page can be framed by an attacker.
sec-frame-options.frameAncestors: Framing is restricted by CSP frame-ancestors.

email-spf.title: SPF record
email-spf.recommendation: Publish one SPF TXT record listing your mail senders and ending in -all (or ~all while testing). Domains that send no mail can use "v=spf1 -all".
email-spf.unknown: The SPF record could not be looked up.
email-spf.missing: {domain} has no SPF record, so anyone can send email that claims to come from it.
email-spf.multiple: {domain} has {count} SPF records; receivers treat that as an error and ignore all of them.
email-spf.weak: The SPF record does not reject unlisted senders.
email-spf.valid: A valid SPF record is published.

email-dmarc.title: DMARC policy
email-dmarc.recommendation: Publish a DMARC record at _dmarc on your domain; start with p=none and a reporting address, then move to p=quarantine or p=reject.
email-dmarc.unknown: The DMARC record could not be looked up.
email-dmarc.missing: {domain} has no DMARC policy, so receivers have no instruction for spoofed mail.
email-dmarc.multiple: {domain} publishes {count} DMARC records; receivers then apply none of them.
email-dmarc.enforced: DMARC policy is "{policy}"{inherited, select, yes { (inherited from {source})} other {}}.
email-dmarc.monitoring: DMARC only monitors (p=none){inherited, select, yes { (inherited from {source})} other {}}; spoofed mail is still delivered.
email-dmarc.invalid: The DMARC record has no valid policy{inherited, select, yes { (inherited from {source})} other {}}.

seo-title-missing.title: Page has no title tag
seo-title-missing.recommendation: Add a unique 40–60 character title in your theme or SEO plugin settings.
seo-title-missing.present: The page has a title tag.
seo-title-missing.missing: The homepage does not expose a title tag. Search engines and AI answer engines fall back to the domain name or arbitrary page text.

seo-title-short.title: Title tag is very short
seo-title-short.recommendation: Expand the title to 40–60 characters including the primary topic and brand.
seo-title-short.short: The title is {length} characters, which usually means it carries no descriptive keywords.

seo-title-long.title: Title tag is likely truncated
seo-title-long.recommendation: Trim the title to about 60 characters, keeping the most important words first.
seo-title-long.long: The title is {length} characters and will be cut off in most search results.

seo-meta-desc-missing.title: Missing meta description
seo-meta-desc-missing.recommendation: Add a 120–160 character meta description summarising the page.
seo-meta-desc-missing.present: The page has a meta description.
seo-meta-desc-missing.missing: No meta description was found, so search engines generate their own snippet from page text.

seo-meta-desc-short.title: Meta description is too short
seo-meta-desc-short.short: The meta description is {length} characters, too short to use the available snippet space.

seo-canonical-missing.title: No canonical URL declared
seo-canonical-missing.recommendation: Add a canonical link pointing at the preferred URL.
seo-canonical-missing.missing: Without a canonical link, duplicate URLs (with and without trailing slash, query parameters, or www) can compete with each other.

seo-noindex.title: Page is marked noindex
seo-noindex.recommendation: Remove the noindex directive unless this page is intentionally hidden.
seo-noindex.indexable: Search engines may index the page.
seo-noindex.noindex: A robots meta tag tells search engines not to index this page. If this is the live homepage, the site is invisible in search.

seo-schema-missing.title: No structured data (schema.org)
seo-schema-missing.recommendation: Publish Organization (or LocalBusiness) structured data in the page head.
seo-schema-missing.present: The page publishes JSON-LD structured data.
seo-schema-missing.missing: The page publishes no JSON-LD structured data, so search engines and AI answer engines have to infer what the business is, where it operates and how to contact it.

seo-og-missing.title: Incomplete social sharing tags
seo-og-missing.recommendation: Add og:title, og:description, og:image and twitter:card tags.
seo-og-missing.present: Open Graph title and image are set.
seo-og-missing.missing: Open Graph tags are missing, so links shared on social platforms and messaging apps render without a proper title or preview image.
seo-og-missing.incomplete: Open Graph tags are incomplete, so links shared on social platforms and messaging apps render without a proper title or preview image.

seo-h1-missing.title: No H1 heading
seo-h1-missing.recommendation: Add exactly one H1 that states what the page is about.
seo-h1-missing.present: The page has an H1 heading.
seo-h1-missing.missing: The page has no H1, so the main topic is not stated in the document outline.

seo-h1-multiple.title: Multiple H1 headings
seo-h1-multiple.recommendation: Keep one H1 and demote the rest to H2.
seo-h1-multiple.ok: The page has no more than one H1.
seo-h1-multiple.multiple: The page has {count} H1 elements, which dilutes the topical signal.

sec-no-https.title: Site is not served over HTTPS
sec-no-https.recommendation: Install a TLS certificate and redirect all HTTP traffic to HTTPS.
sec-no-https.https: The site is served over HTTPS.
sec-no-https.http: The final URL after redirects is plain HTTP. All traffic, including form submissions, travels unencrypted.

sec-version-disclosure.title: Server software version disclosed
sec-version-disclosure.recommendation: Suppress version numbers in the Server and X-Powered-By headers.
sec-version-disclosure.hidden: Response headers do not reveal software versions.
sec-version-disclosure.disclosed: Response headers reveal exact software versions, which helps an attacker match known exploits.

sec-wp-xmlrpc.title: XML-RPC is reachable
sec-wp-xmlrpc.recommendation: Disable XML-RPC unless a connected app depends on it.
sec-wp-xmlrpc.unknown: Whether xmlrpc.php is reachable could not be determined.
sec-wp-xmlrpc.reachable: xmlrpc.php is enabled. It is a common target for brute-force amplification and pingback abuse, and almost no modern site needs it.

sec-wp-user-enum.title: User enumeration is possible
sec-wp-user-enum.unknown: The WordPress users endpoint could not be checked.
sec-wp-user-enum.blocked: The WordPress users endpoint does not list usernames to anonymous visitors.
sec-wp-user-enum.exposed: The WordPress REST API exposes /wp-json/wp/v2/users, letting anyone list valid usernames for a brute-force attempt.

sec-wp-version-exposed.title: WordPress version is public
sec-wp-version-exposed.hidden: The page does not advertise the WordPress version.
sec-wp-version-exposed.exposed: The generator meta tag advertises WordPress {version}, making it trivial to look up matching vulnerabilities.

a11y-img-alt.title: Images without alt text
a11y-img-alt.recommendation: Add descriptive alt text, or an empty alt attribute for images that are purely decorative.
a11y-img-alt.ok: All images have an alt attribute.
a11y-img-alt.missing: {missing} of {total} images ({ratio}%) have no alt attribute, so screen readers announce nothing for them.

a11y-lang-missing.title: No document language declared
a11y-lang-missing.recommendation: Add the correct language code (for example lang="en") to the html element.
a11y-lang-missing.missing: The html element has no lang attribute, so screen readers cannot choose the right pronunciation rules.

a11y-heading-structure.title: No top-level heading for navigation
a11y-heading-structure.recommendation: Add a single H1 as the first heading on the page.
a11y-heading-structure.present: The page has a top-level heading.
a11y-heading-structure.missing: Screen reader users navigate by headings. With no H1 there is no entry point to the page structure.

perf-script-count.title: Large number of script tags
perf-script-count.recommendation: Bundle or defer non-critical scripts and remove unused plugins.
perf-script-count.many: {count} script elements were found in the HTML. Each one is a parse and, usually, a network round trip.

perf-image-count.title: Very image-heavy page
perf-image-count.recommendation: Lazy-load below-the-fold images and serve modern formats (WebP/AVIF).
perf-image-count.many: {count} images are referenced on a single page.

perf-html-size.title: HTML document is very large
perf-html-size.recommendation: Move inline styles and data blobs out of the document and paginate long pages.
perf-html-size.ok: The HTML document is about {kb} KB.
perf-html-size.large: The HTML response is roughly {kb} KB before any assets load.

perf-no-compression.title: HTML is served uncompressed
perf-no-compression.recommendation: Enable Brotli or gzip compression at the server or CDN.
perf-no-compression.uncompressed: No Content-Encoding header was returned, so the document transfers at full size.

perf-no-cache-header.title: No Cache-Control header
perf-no-cache-header.recommendation: Set an explicit Cache-Control policy for HTML and static assets.
perf-no-cache-header.missing: Without explicit caching rules, browsers and CDNs have to guess how long the response stays fresh.

content-title-length.title: Page title length
content-title-length.recommendation: Keep the page title between 30 and 60 characters.
content-title-length.ok: The title is {length} characters, within the 30–60 range.
content-title-length.outside: The title is {length} characters, outside the 30–60 range.

content-desc-length.title: Meta description length
content-desc-length.recommendation: Keep the meta description between 120 and 160 characters.
content-desc-length.ok: The meta description is {length} characters, within the 120–160 range.
content-desc-length.outside: The meta description is {length} characters, outside the 120–160 range.
